r5.runtime: Eden run recorded by the tester: sampling worked (samples 1 to 11, Long Sword 300/300 down to 260/300, tier 3, three walked nodes) and the HUD changed nothing. The insertion reported stage 20 at the first update and stopped retrying.
r5.defects_found: The row does not exist while the gauge HUD is absent, so stage 20 is a normal early state and must be retryable; the instance capture recorded the last instance that called the walker instead of the gauge instance; the row map is [controller, bar, effect, edge] with the group above the bar, so indexing map[1] as the group is wrong.

r6.runtime: Eden run recorded by the tester: retrying works (stage 20 reported every 4 seconds, matching the 240-attempt cadence) and sampling is correct (Long Sword 300/300 down to 267/300, tier 3). No mask was inserted; the row validation kept failing and stage 20 named no gate.
r6.changes: Instance capture only records a pair whose instance+0xdc is the gauge controller; row discovery derives the group from bar+0x70 and checks the bar/effect/edge chain in both directions with the bar identified by its authored 88x24 size; stage 20 retries every 240 attempts.
r6.defects_found: A single "row absent" code cannot say which check failed, so a run gives no diagnosis. The bar's live texture rect in the log (300 96 320) is not the archive rect (0 280 88 304), which shows the animation rewrites the rect and that demanding the authored 88x24 as a hard gate is the wrong contract.

r7.runtime: Eden run recorded by the tester: stage 21 while the gauge was absent, then stage 24 from 294 s with instance=0x47dfaf00 and controller=gauge=0x485994b0, matching the sample ctrl field. The instance capture and controller match work; the row gates failed. No mask inserted, nothing changed on screen.
r7.defects_found: The gates required the counter row layout copied from Key Quest Markers: a drawable count at row+8, where the gauge row has a pointer-like value, plus root+0x50 == 1 as a hard gate.

r8.changes: Row identity from the proven fields (4 / 4 / 15 / 29); cache length from sampling drawables; root+0x50 recorded in the clip line instead of gating; 13 host fixtures pass.
